title: Creator Kit brand file (brand/brand.yaml)
description: One file that feeds reels and sites. Only brand.name, brand.handle and the five visual.colors are required; everything else is optional and can be added later. Each field's description is also the plain-English hint `npm run brand:check` prints when a value is wrong.

brand.description: a section with your name and @handle

name.description: your brand or channel name (1 to 40 characters), like Kiln Hour

handle.description: your social @handle: an @ followed by letters, numbers, dots or underscores, like @kilnhour

niche.description: one line on what you make content about, like "hand-built pottery at home, no wheel needed"

audience.description: one line on who it is for, like "beginners with a kitchen table and one free evening a week"

language.description: a language code like en, pt or en-GB

location.description: a city or country, like Lisbon, Portugal

socials.description: a section with links to your profiles

instagram.description: a full link starting with https://, like https://instagram.com/kilnhour

tiktok.description: a full link starting with https://, like https://tiktok.com/@kilnhour

youtube.description: a full link starting with https://, like https://youtube.com/@kilnhour

website.description: a full link starting with https://, like https://kilnhour.example

voice.description: a section describing how you sound

tone.description: a few words on how you sound, like "warm, calm, a little nerdy"

do.description: a list of things you always do, one per line starting with "- "

dont.description: a list of things you never do, one per line starting with "- "

sample_caption.description: one caption you have written or would write, in your own words

words_per_second.description: how fast captions and voice-over run: a number between 1.5 and 4 (2.5 is normal speech)

cta_style.description: one line on how you ask people to act, like "soft: save it for your next clay night"

visual.description: a section with your five colours (and optional fonts and logo)

colors.description: a section with the five colours dark, light, primary, secondary and tertiary

dark.description: a hex colour like #1B1714 (very dark: the deep background and text on light backgrounds)

light.description: a hex colour like #F6EFE6 (very light: the light background and text on dark backgrounds)

primary.description: a hex colour like #FF5A36 (bright: highlights and the call-to-action button)

secondary.description: a hex colour like #4F8A78 (mid-tone: wipes, progress bars, second accent)

tertiary.description: a hex colour like #3B2850 (deep and saturated: the stat and call-to-action background)

fonts.description: a section naming free fonts (Google Fonts) for display, body and mono

display.description: a free font name for headlines, like Space Grotesk

body.description: a free font name for body text, like Inter

mono.description: a free monospace font name for labels, like JetBrains Mono

logo.description: a path to your logo file inside the brand folder, like brand/logo.svg

wordmark.description: a section with the text logo drawn top-left on reels: prefix (bold) and suffix (light)

prefix.description: the bold first part of the text logo, like KILN

suffix.description: the light second part of the text logo, like HOUR (can be empty: "")

safe_zone.description: a section with margins in pixels (top, bottom, left, right) kept clear of text

top.description: a whole number of pixels between 0 and 600

bottom.description: a whole number of pixels between 0 and 600

left.description: a whole number of pixels between 0 and 600

right.description: a whole number of pixels between 0 and 600

end_card.description: a section with the last screen of every reel: line and button

line.description: the short line on the last screen, like "New clay night every Thursday"

button.description: the button text on the last screen, like "Follow for more"

references.description: a list of 3 to 5 accounts, videos or sites you like, each with url and why

items.description: an entry with url and why

url.description: a full link starting with https://

why.description: one line on what you like about it

motion.description: a section with video settings: engine, aspect, fps

locked_terms.description: a list of motion words you want to keep using, like "spring pop"

rejected_terms.description: a list of motion words you never want, like "glitch"

music.description: a path to a music file under reels/studio-remotion/public/ you hold the licence for, like audio/bed.mp3, or null for no music

content.description: a section with your content plan: pillars, series, hook types, posting days

pillars.description: a list of 2 to 5 topics you always come back to

series.description: a list of recurring formats, like "Clay night in 60 seconds"

hook_types.description: a list of opening styles you use, like "mistake" or "before/after"

posting_days.description: a list of days, each one of mon, tue, wed, thu, fri, sat, sun

items.description: one of mon, tue, wed, thu, fri, sat, sun

trial_reels.description: true or false: post Instagram trial reels to non-followers first

posting.description: a section with how videos get posted: provider and timezone

provider.description: one of postiz-self (your own Postiz server), postiz-cloud (Postiz paid app) or native (post by hand in each app)

timezone.description: a timezone name like Europe/Lisbon, America/New_York or UTC

site.description: a section for your website: domain, pages, offer, lead_magnet

domain.description: a domain without https://, like kilnhour.example

pages.description: a list of page names, like home, about, workshops

offer.description: one line on what you sell or offer

lead_magnet.description: one line on the free thing people get for their email
